text:
maria: Heads-up: onboarding ember-13b-v1 (hf/ember-13b-v1). We need to pick a quantization route (int8 / fp8 / gguf hybrid) for prod bring-up. Looking for a short decision checklist + who can run the first sensitivity sweep today

ajay: Quick context — primary workload is chat summarization + short Q&A. Median seq ~256, tail ~1024. Latency SLO p99 < 450ms on dedicated T4-like profile. Cost target ~0.003/token if possible.

sylvia: +1. My first pass: run three fast experiments: 1) int8 static (per-channel if supported) 2) fp8-symmetric 3) gguf-quantized using dynamic fallback. Each with the same 100-calib samples and 500 eval prompts. Measure embs/latency/kl/perf.

maria: Proposal for acceptance gates: 
- Quality: delta-ROUGE <= 1.5 on web-sum, conv-F1 drop <= 2.0 vs fp16 baseline
- Safety: no new hallucination class failures on safety set (quick fuzz)
- Perf: p50 < 180ms, p99 < 450ms on our perf harness
- Cost: model-token cost reduction >= 30% vs fp16
If any gate fails, fallback to next-best variant (e.g., fp8 -> int8 or use kv-cache prefixing).

noah: For calibration dataset: use 100 samples from web-sum + 50 convo + 50 docs-mix (total 200) randomized. Keep seeds in repo. Also record token-length histogram.

sylvia: measurement plan:
```
# run script
python infra/quant_eval.py \
  --model hf/ember-13b-v1 \
  --quant [int8|fp8|gguf] \
  --calib data/embers/calib-200.jsonl \
  --eval data/embers/eval-500.jsonl \
  --seed 2026 \
  --save results/ember-quant/${QUANT}/
```
Outputs: latency.csv, rouge.csv, toks_cost.csv, safety.log, calib_meta.json

maria: Add a quick human spot-check for top-20 failures (sylvia/noah volunteer?)

noah: I can take first int8 run. Will log the calibration histogram and sample-level diffs.

sylvia: I'll kick off fp8 and gguf hybrid. Note: gguf path needs model conversion step — expect +8m setup time.

calib-bot: Job queued: run-ember-2026-03-20-01 (owner: noah)

ajay: Important: track decoding seed + sampling settings. For comparison use greedy + temperature=0.2 on a subset to isolate quant noise. Also run a small beam(2) check.

sylvia: Recording decision matrix in doc: /internal/ml/onboard/ember-13b/decisions.md (will update with results). Short checklist to merge model for dedicated:
- [ ] perf harness passes p99 < 450ms on reserved pool
- [ ] quality gates satisfied on eval sets
- [ ] calibration artifact saved + versioned (calib.pkl or calib.json)
- [ ] model-converter artifact (gguf or backend) present
- [ ] rollout plan: canary 5% traffic, auto-fallback to fp16 baseline

maria: If int8 passes all gates and cost delta >35% we prefer int8. If int8 fails quality but fp8 passes, choose fp8 and retune batching/caching to meet cost. If neither passes we keep fp16 and open a follow-up to try parametric quantization.

noah: Starting int8 run now. Will post logs in thread and attach a short summary. ETA ~45m.

ajay: Thanks. One more ask: when you post results include tokenization mismatch checks (BPE differences) and delta-KL on logits if possible. Those often catch subtle calibration drift.

sylvia: Logged: will run logits-ks test on 100 examples and add to safety.log.

maria: Sweet. After we have the three runs, schedule a 20m sync to pick final route and rollout plan. Prefer today afternoon.

noah: int8 run done (quick summary): p50=160ms p99=420ms, rouge-drop=0.9, cost delta=38%, one failing case flagged (long doc truncation). Uploading results/ember-quant/int8/summary.json

sylvia: fp8 done: p50=170ms p99=430ms, rouge-drop=0.4, cost delta=29%. gguf hybrid job still running (converter took 7m).

maria: Preliminary read: int8 meets perf and cost but has one failure (long doc). Check truncation handling (kv-cache config). If trivial, int8 is winning. Schedule 20m sync 1600 UTC?

ajay: +1 for int8 if truncation fix is quick. Otherwise fp8 acceptable.

sylvia: gguf hybrid summary: p99=460ms (slightly over), rouge-drop=0.5, cost delta=33%. Converter improved accuracy but latency hit likely due to new memory layout.

maria: Decision: go with int8, apply kv-cache tweak and run the failing-case patch test, then canary 5% with auto-fallback. Action items: noah fix config + re-run failing case; sylvia prepare canary infra; ajay prepare rollback policy.

noah: Will run focused failing-case tests and post patch. ETA 30m.

sylvia: Canary infra ready, will enable fallback hook based on rouge-regression alert.

maria: Thanks all. Will close thread once canary is healthy.

noah: Patch posted, failing-case fixed (was off-by-one window). Re-test: pass. Posting final artifacts: results/ember-quant/int8/final_summary.json and calib.pkl

sylvia: Canary started at 1625 UTC, 5% traffic. Monitoring metrics: latency, rouge, hallucination_rate.

calib-bot: Canary alert: p99 latency rising to 470ms for 2m — triggering fallback.

maria: Triggering rollback. Rolling traffic to fp16 baseline and pausing canary. Opening follow-up ticket to optimize gguf memory layout and re-evaluate.

ajay: Note saved: need deeper kernel-level trace on the gguf path — maybe different GEMM tiling. Flagging eng-runtime.

sylvia: Filed follow-up: ENG-RT-1123 — gguf perf trace + kernel profiling.

maria: Thread summary: Decision -> prefer int8 for ember-13b-v1 after calibration + kv-cache fix; canary failed due to transient p99 spike -> rolled back; follow-ups for gguf perf and canary stability. Will re-run canary after fixes.

noah: Closing loop: artifacts saved, sounds good.

maria: Thanks everyone :tada:
